title: agenda.json for one school year (input to the reminders epic)
description: Its content depends only on what was synced and on the family's decisions, never on the day it is generated; that is why it carries no timestamp (the log does).

item.description: Id of the item; a detected exam is «<item>#exam-<k>»

list.description: Sections «Pendiente», «Hecho» and «Publicado» of agenda.md, per FR-020c

date.description: ISO 8601 in Europe/Madrid; null = no date

date_only.description: true if Classroom gives no time

classroom_link.description: Classroom URL without /u/<n> or any student data; the readable agenda says to open it with the school account

folder.description: Path relative to the student's root; null if the item has no replica
